Content.SourceString: （照片）
Content.LocalizedString: (Photo)

Content.SourceString: 相片，里尔·斯·海特洛……斜视、丑……丢狗脸。
Content.LocalizedString: Photo, Ruddy S. Hethereau… cross-eyed, ugly… embarrassing.

Content.SourceString: 不好意思，刚刚是里尔在用脸滚屏幕，吓到您了吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, Ruddy was rolling his face on the screen just now. Did he scare you?

Content.SourceString: 里尔的意思是，他感觉自己这张照片有点斜视。
Content.LocalizedString: Ruddy means he looks a bit cross-eyed in this photo.

Content.SourceString: 斜视？有吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Cross-eyed? Really?

Content.SourceString: 确实有点斜视问题……
Content.LocalizedString: He is indeed a bit cross-eyed here…

Content.SourceString: 他的形象包袱确实很重，但在某些事情上，纯粹是他想得有点多。
Content.LocalizedString: It is difficult to uphold his image, but sometimes, he is just overthinking.

Content.SourceString: 斜，丑，里尔·海特洛……哭
Content.LocalizedString: Cross-eyed, ugly, Ruddy Hethereau… crying.

Content.SourceString: 对了朋友，我们准备买个大相框裱起来，把这张照片挂在家里。
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, buddy, we're going to buy a big frame and hang this photo at home.

Content.SourceString: 毕竟这是我们友谊的见证，可是具有纪念意义的照片嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: It's a testament to our friendship, a very meaningful photo.

Content.SourceString: 如果您想来看照片，欢迎随时来我们家参观。
Content.LocalizedString: If you want to see the photo, feel free to visit our house.

Content.SourceString: （照片）
Content.LocalizedString: (Photo)

Content.SourceString: 我们给灵魂提取器刨的墓。
Content.LocalizedString: We dug a grave for the Soultractor.

Content.SourceString: 我们一直在犹豫该怎样处理这家伙，后来还是决定把它埋了。
Content.LocalizedString: We've been hesitant about what to do with it and decided to bury it in the end.

Content.SourceString: 虽然灵魂提取器是一个可怕的异象，但作为对手，我们还是决定给予它应得的尊重。
Content.LocalizedString: Although the Soultractor is a terrifying anomaly… we should respect it as opponents.

OptionText.SourceString: 为什么认为提取器是异象？
OptionText.LocalizedString: What makes you think the extractor is an anomaly?

OptionText.SourceString: 分开的不是灵魂提取器……
OptionText.LocalizedString: It's not the Soultractor that separated…

Content.SourceString: ……为什么认为灵魂提取器是异象？
Content.LocalizedString: What makes you think the Soultractor is an anomaly?

Content.SourceString: 有、错吗。因为灵魂……分开……
Content.LocalizedString: Is it… not? Because the soul… separated…

Content.SourceString: 大概分裂与复合，取决于你们自己本身……
Content.LocalizedString: The division and fusion probably depend on you…

Content.SourceString: 而不是灵魂提取器本身。
Content.LocalizedString: And not the Soultractor itself.

Content.SourceString: 所以当我们彼此都不愿意与对方在一起时，我们就会分开？
Content.LocalizedString: So when neither of us wants to be together, we separate?

Content.SourceString: 当我们都有着想要与对方重归于好的强烈愿望，就会重新成为三头犬？
Content.LocalizedString: When we both strongly wish to reunite, do we become Cerberus again?

Content.SourceString: 应该是这样。
Content.LocalizedString: It sounds about right.

Content.SourceString: 真相了。
Content.LocalizedString: That's the truth.

Content.SourceString: 没想到居然会是这个样子……
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't expect it to turn out like this…

Content.SourceString: 奥尔、断爪子……坑、白、刨……
Content.LocalizedString: Auddy, broken claw… pit, white, digging…

Content.SourceString: 自从上次广告打出去之后，找我们合作的客户更多了。
Content.LocalizedString: More clients have come to us for collaboration ever since the last advertisement.

Content.SourceString: 但不知道为什么我们总是会接到像是遛猫、遛鸭、遛棉绒绒、遛谜皮鬼……这些奇奇怪怪的遛宠工作。可我们是专业遛狗的……
Content.LocalizedString: But for some reason, we always get odd pet-walking jobs like walking cats, ducks, Fluffy, Mysty… But we are professional dog walkers…

Content.SourceString: 现在海特洛市养宠人的精神状态都这么美丽了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Has the mental state of pet owners in Hethereau become so unstable?

Content.SourceString: 朋友您有什么好的建议吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have any good suggestions, buddy?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Refine your dog walking skills until it is excellent.

OptionText.SourceString: 拓展海特洛市遛宠版图。
OptionText.LocalizedString: Expand the pet-walking business of Hethereau.

Content.SourceString: 主攻遛狗、做精做优。
Content.LocalizedString: Focus on dog walking and perfect it.

Content.SourceString: 广泛涉猎、拓展海特洛市遛宠版图。
Content.LocalizedString: Cover more aspects and expand the pet-walking business of Hethereau.

Content.SourceString: 很有趣的想法，朋友，如果朋友需要遛宠，我们可以给你打折，只需要一点美味大骨头！汪汪！
Content.LocalizedString: An interesting idea, friend! If you need pet walking services, we can offer a discount—just a Yummers Bone will do! Woof woof!

Content.SourceString: 让汪想想名号，就叫海特洛溜宠第一汪！
Content.LocalizedString: Let me think of a name. How about "Hethereau's Top Dog Walker"?

Content.SourceString: 汪汪汪汪汪！
Content.LocalizedString: Woof, woof, woof, woof, woof!

Content.SourceString: ……里尔？
Content.LocalizedString: …Ruddy?

Content.SourceString: 是汪！汪想找好朋友玩的汪！
Content.LocalizedString: Yes, woof! I just wanna find some good friends to play with—woof!

Content.SourceString: （还有我！我也要。）
Content.LocalizedString: (And me! I want to too!)

Content.SourceString: 朋友，通讯设备说不明白，我们在半角街等你。
Content.LocalizedString: Friend, it's hard to explain over the communication device. We'll wait for you on Hankaku Street.

Content.SourceString: 好朋友的汪，记得来的汪！
Content.LocalizedString: Good friend woof, remember to come, woof!

Content.SourceString: 好朋友的汪，记得来的汪！
Content.LocalizedString: Good friend woof, remember to come, woof!
Walk&*…%woof…&…found…

Content.SourceString: 怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: What's wrong?

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，朋友，奥尔在查询信息时不小心脸滚键盘。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, friend. Auddy accidentally face-rolled the keyboard while looking up info.

Content.SourceString: 奥尔是笨蛋汪！汪，聪明，汪，不会！
Content.LocalizedString: Auddy is stupid, woof! Woof, smart, woof, can't!

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，朋友，我们得继续处理麻烦事了，奥尔接下来会小心点的。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, friend, we need to keep dealing with some trouble. Auddy will be more careful from now on.

Content.SourceString: 没关系。
Content.LocalizedString: No problem.

Content.SourceString: 没关系。
Content.LocalizedString: No problem.

Content.SourceString: 朋友，从上次的事情后，来找我们代言的人变多了起来。
Content.LocalizedString: Friend, ever since that last incident, more people have been coming to us for endorsements.

Content.SourceString: 灵魂提取器和三头犬的故事似乎很受人的欢迎。
Content.LocalizedString: The story of the Soultractor and Cerberus seems to be quite popular with people.

Content.SourceString: 不过，我们也有一些困惑。
Content.LocalizedString: However, we do have some confusion about things.

Content.SourceString: 朋友，你有时间吗？我们需要你的慷慨解答。
Content.LocalizedString: Friend, do you have time? We need your generous help with some answers.

Content.SourceString: 好。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay.

Content.SourceString: 好。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay.
